cases.sentence: Авраам взял себе другую ___, которую звали Хитура.
cases.translation: Abraham took himself another wife, whose name was Keturah.
cases.explain: Жена is the direct object of взял (took) → accusative; feminine -а nouns take -у.

cases.sentence: Авраам оставил всё, что у него было, ___.
cases.translation: Abraham left all that he had to Isaac.
cases.explain: Исаак is the recipient of оставил (left to) — the indirect object → dative.

cases.sentence: …и отослал их от своего ___ Исаака на восток.
cases.translation: …and sent them away from his son Isaac, eastward.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive → сына.

cases.sentence: Там Авраам был погребён рядом со своей женой ___.
cases.translation: There Abraham was buried beside his wife Sarah.
cases.explain: The phrase рядом с (beside/together with) takes the instrumental → Сарой.

cases.sentence: Исааку было сорок лет, когда он женился на ___.
cases.translation: Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah.
cases.explain: The verb жениться на (to marry) takes на + prepositional → Ревекке.

cases.sentence: ___ ответил на его молитву, и его жена Ревекка забеременела.
cases.translation: The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject that performs ответил (answered) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Он испустил последний вздох и умер… и отошёл к своим ___.
cases.translation: He breathed his last and died… and was gathered to his ancestors.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always governs the dative → предкам (dative plural).

cases.translation: Esau came back from the field very hungry.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning 'from' governs the genitive → поля.

reading.ru: Авраам взял себе другую жену, которую звали Хитура.
reading.question: Whom did Abraham take as another wife?
reading.explain: The text says Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

reading.ru: Авраам оставил все, что у него было, Исааку.
reading.question: To whom did Abraham leave everything he owned?
reading.explain: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

reading.question: How many years did Abraham live in all?
reading.explain: The text states Abraham lived a total of 175 years.

reading.ru: Его сыновья Исаак и Измаил похоронили его в пещере Махпела рядом с Мамре на поле Хетта-Эфрона, сына Цахара, которое Авраам купил у Хеттов.
reading.question: Who buried Abraham in the cave of Machpelah?
reading.explain: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah.

reading.question: How many years did Ishmael live?
reading.explain: The text says Ishmael lived 137 years.

reading.question: What did Esau ultimately do with his birthright?
options: He gave it to his father
reading.explain: Having sold it for stew, Esau despised his birthright.
